body.name: Perron priority order
body.construction: For each connected component of \(G_n\), take a positive unit-norm Perron eigenvector of the component block of \(\mathcal H_n\), assign ranks by decreasing coordinate with label ties, and concatenate components by their smallest label. This defines the unit-to-rank map \(\pi_n\), its inverse \(\rho_n=\pi_n^{-1}\), and \(B_{n,i}=\{j:\{i,j\}\in G_n,\ \pi_n(j)<\pi_n(i)\}\).
